name: Paulinho Pimpas Ribeiro
bio:
Renowned for his impeccable mastery in the art of black & gray realism, Paulinho Pimpas Ribeiro is a tattoo artist whose professionalism shines through every piece of ink he creates. Clients frequently commend Paulinho's dedication to maintaining a clean and hygienic workspace, ensuring a safe and reassuring experience for anyone who chooses to get tattooed by him. His attention to detail and commitment to cleanliness is as striking as the tattoos that come to life under his skilled hands.
